description: MASSACHUSETTS LEADING MANUFACTURERS HONORED BY LEGISLATORS AT 10TH ANNUAL MANUFACTURING AWARDS CEREMONY AT GILLETTE STADIUM FOXBOROUGH, MA – State Representative Steven Ultrino (D-Malden) is honored to announce that Malden’s Alsym Energy is a 2025 recipient of the "Manufacturer of the Year” Award presented by the Massachusetts Legislative Manufacturing Caucus.
